task: Zero-recurring-cost signing policy and SignPath application path

adr.supersedes: ADR 0004 signing/notarization section and related acceptance criteria

windows.strategy: SignPath Foundation free OSS signing only
windows.reason_official_form_not_submitted: SignPath Foundation's published conditions require the project to already be released in the form to be signed and documented on a download page. Notanda currently intentionally has no public installer/download artifact. Submitting as already eligible would conflict with the project's current public-release boundary.

inquiry.subject: SignPath Foundation OSS signing — Notanda eligibility before application
inquiry.question: Whether a public source repository plus technically validated but restricted-beta MSI is eligible before a public unsigned installer exists.

macos.strategy: Continue ad-hoc signing; no paid Apple Developer Program membership
macos.gatekeeper_primary_path: System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Security -> Open Anyway -> Open
macos.secondary_path_note: Control-click/right-click -> Open may work on some configurations but is not the canonical documented path.
macos.accepted_tradeoff: The original no-friction double-click goal cannot be fully met on macOS without Developer ID/notarization. One-time Gatekeeper friction remains; managed Macs may forbid the override.
